SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, min(calendar_date) AS d0, max(calendar_date) AS d1, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS closed_days
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 AND r.store_id <> 999
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, w.net_sales, c.ctrl_net, w.net_sales - c.ctrl_net AS diff
FROM weekly w JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT 'sales_dup_ids' AS chk, count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS v FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_dup_receipt_line', count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'return_dup_ids', count(*) - count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_delivered_order', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected'))
UNION ALL SELECT 'maxload', max(CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE)) - DATE '2000-01-01' FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'ly_p2_closed_stores', count(*) FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-06-28' AND closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-05-26'

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 16

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period, count(*) AS dup_rows, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT CAST(f.etl_loaded_at AS DATE)) AS load_days
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = f.sale_date
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, count(DISTINCT r.store_id) FILTER (WHERE r.store_id < 900) AS stores, count(DISTINCT r.business_date) AS days,
  sum(r.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE r.store_id = 900) AS web, sum(r.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE r.store_id < 900) AS stores_net, sum(r.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE r.store_id = 999) AS s999
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,1

WITH o AS (
  SELECT status, order_total_gross,
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS od,
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order
)
SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.fiscal_week, count(*) AS orders_by_order_date, sum(order_total_gross) AS gross_by_order_date,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='cancelled') AS cancelled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='processing') AS processing,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE dd IS NOT NULL AND dd - od > 3) AS slow_dispatch
FROM o JOIN dim_date a ON a.calendar_date = o.od
WHERE a.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND a.fiscal_week BETWEEN 4 AND 9
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,1

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 2 AS period_no
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_period = params.period_no
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty CROSS JOIN params
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
